title: Flashcards: Official languages, Oceania
intro: Flip each card about Oceania. Mark the ones you knew; the others come back sooner. Every answer shows its source.

cards.front: Which languages are official in Fiji?
cards.explain: English, Fiji Hindi, Fijian are official languages of Fiji.

cards.front: Which language is official in Micronesia (Federated States of)?
cards.explain: English is the official language of Micronesia (Federated States of).

cards.front: Which languages are official in Kiribati?
cards.explain: English, Gilbertese are official languages of Kiribati.

cards.front: Which languages are official in Marshall Islands?
cards.explain: English, Marshallese are official languages of Marshall Islands.

cards.front: Which languages are official in Naoero?
cards.explain: English, Nauru are official languages of Naoero.

cards.front: Which language is official in New Zealand?
cards.explain: Maori is the official language of New Zealand.

cards.front: Which languages are official in Papua New Guinea?
cards.explain: English, Hiri Motu, Tok Pisin are official languages of Papua New Guinea.

cards.front: Which languages are official in Palau?
cards.explain: English, Palauan are official languages of Palau.

cards.front: Which language is official in Solomon Islands?
cards.explain: English is the official language of Solomon Islands.

cards.front: Which languages are official in Tonga?
cards.explain: English, Tonga (Tonga Islands) are official languages of Tonga.

cards.front: Which languages are official in Vanuatu?
cards.explain: Bislama, English, French are official languages of Vanuatu.

cards.front: Which languages are official in Samoa?
cards.explain: English, Samoan are official languages of Samoa.
